entries.subject: DAMIT 152: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-152.txt. Model 152, version 2009-02-26, pole (149°, -55°), period 10.9258 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 91 ±1 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal diameter as an alternative scale
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the documented physical calibration supplies the selected scale. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 82.97 ± 0.81 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 110 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-specific comparison with the selected shape and physical calibration justifies changing the adopted scale.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 153, pole ['331', '-61'], [Model 153](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/153) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 153: pole (331°, -61°), 10.9258 h, version 2009-02-26, archive diameter 95.5 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "45.5 km (size-calibrated model)" (damit-models) implies a diameter of 91 km, outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 90, DAMIT model 153 diameter 81 ± 2 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 153 fitted to 4 occultations). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
